mechanism: Establish one presenter silhouette and a bounded paper-card vocabulary, progressively reorganize and duplicate those established elements to increase information density, then simplify once and resolve the same family into a held final graphic composition.

invariants.rule: Establish one stable presenter silhouette and bounded card vocabulary.
invariants.ablation_failure: Unbounded assets make the collage arbitrary.

invariants.rule: Reorganize information using only established shapes, palette and presenter identity.
invariants.ablation_failure: New unrelated art breaks the system.

invariants.rule: Use duplication or offset repetition to raise density while retaining identity.
invariants.ablation_failure: Replacing the presenter loses the anchor.

invariants.rule: Simplify once before the final reconstruction.
Resolve established elements into a held final lockup without source copy.
invariants.ablation_failure: Copying the source end card violates transfer.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: the source Arabic presenter and identity
the exact Arabic copy and title cards
